profile.legalName: Student Program For Academic And Athletic Transitioning
profile.summary: SPAAT is an Oakland nonprofit that supports high school student-athletes. It offers mentoring, tutoring and coaching to help students move from high school to college, careers and adulthood. It was founded in 2003 and works with students in Oakland schools.
